title: Compliant distance joint as a spring: the trajectory is the scheme's closed form x' = (x + h v) / (1 + w^2 h^2)

tol.derivation: position rounding over the run (2 quanta + 2u|dx| per substep) plus the f32 rounding of the 1 m anchor offset (u L) amplified by the spring over a substep (w h)
tol.source: XPBD compliance alpha~ = alpha / h^2 (Macklin et al. 2016); closed form of the scheme
